page.overview:
What is The Goblet?

The Goblet is a residential area from Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn, located in Thanalan. It is a resort village where the players can purchase a house for their Free Company or as a private homeowner.

This residential district is located within a desert canyon carved by a river. Housing plots are located on cliff. A number of windmills supply water to the zone. All houses must conform to the "Oasis" style using Ul'dahn architecture. This district also has the Sultana's Breath apartment complex.
